newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 5.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan people stage street rally to protest against violence.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Tens of thousands march for future of Taiwan.
Police continue investigation of murder of renowned actress Pai Ping-ping's daughter.
LIBERTY TIMES - Government officials say they will not ignor public outcry over worsening crime problem.
Visas for Taiwanese nationals to United States will still be issued in Hong Kong after handover.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Banking sector and four other industries to be incorporated under Labour law.
Approval expected for Taiwan stock futures trade.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Chairmen of Intel Corp, Acer Inc and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co meet in high-tech forum.
